SELECT
    TRY_CAST(product_id AS VARCHAR)        AS product_id,
    TRY_CAST(product_name AS VARCHAR)      AS product_name,
    TRY_CAST(category AS VARCHAR)          AS category,
    TRY_CAST(standard_price AS DOUBLE)     AS standard_price
FROM read_csv_auto('C:\Users\chinpavankumar\Downloads\idamp-\idamp\data\uploads\products.csv', all_varchar=true);

SELECT
    TRY_CAST(transaction_id AS VARCHAR)          AS transaction_id,
    TRY_CAST(transaction_date AS VARCHAR)        AS transaction_date,
    TRY_CAST(store_id AS VARCHAR)                AS store_id,
    TRY_CAST(product_id AS VARCHAR)              AS product_id,
    TRY_CAST(product_name AS VARCHAR)            AS product_name,
    TRY_CAST(category AS VARCHAR)                AS category,
    TRY_CAST(quantity AS INTEGER)                AS quantity,
    TRY_CAST(unit_price AS DOUBLE)               AS unit_price,
    TRY_CAST(total_amount AS DOUBLE)             AS total_amount,
    TRY_CAST(customer_segment AS VARCHAR)        AS customer_segment,
    TRY_CAST(payment_method AS VARCHAR)          AS payment_method
FROM read_csv_auto('C:\Users\chinpavankumar\Downloads\idamp-\idamp\data\uploads\sales_data.csv', all_varchar=true);

SELECT
    TRY_CAST(store_id   AS VARCHAR) AS store_id,
    TRY_CAST(store_name AS VARCHAR) AS store_name,
    TRY_CAST(region     AS VARCHAR) AS region,
    TRY_CAST(city       AS VARCHAR) AS city,
    TRY_CAST(state      AS VARCHAR) AS state
FROM read_csv_auto('C:\\Users\\chinpavankumar\\Downloads\\idamp-\\idamp\\data\\uploads\\stores.csv', all_varchar = true);

SELECT DISTINCT
    product_id,
    product_name,
    CASE
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) LIKE 'elec%'                     THEN 'Electronics'
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) LIKE 'apparel%' OR LOWER(TRIM(category)) LIKE 'cloth%' THEN 'Apparel'
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) LIKE 'beauty%' OR LOWER(TRIM(category)) LIKE 'cosmetic%' THEN 'Beauty'
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) LIKE 'sport%'                    THEN 'Sports'
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) LIKE 'home%' OR LOWER(TRIM(category)) LIKE 'kitchen%' THEN 'Home & Kitchen'
        ELSE category
    END AS category,
    COALESCE(
        standard_price,
        (SELECT median(standard_price) FROM products_bronze_6deed7f0)
    ) AS standard_price,
    _load_timestamp,
    _source_file
FROM products_bronze_6deed7f0
WHERE product_name IS NOT NULL
  AND _load_timestamp IS NOT NULL
  AND _source_file IS NOT NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT
    transaction_id,
    COALESCE(
        TRY_STRPTIME(transaction_date, '%Y-%m-%d'),
        TRY_STRPTIME(transaction_date, '%m/%d/%Y')
    )::VARCHAR AS transaction_date,
    store_id,
    product_id,
    product_name,
    CASE
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) LIKE 'elec%'                     THEN 'Electronics'
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) LIKE 'apparel%' OR LOWER(TRIM(category)) LIKE 'cloth%' THEN 'Apparel'
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) LIKE 'beauty%' OR LOWER(TRIM(category)) LIKE 'cosmetic%' THEN 'Beauty'
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) LIKE 'sport%'                     THEN 'Sports'
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) LIKE 'home%' OR LOWER(TRIM(category)) LIKE 'kitchen%' THEN 'Home & Kitchen'
        ELSE category
    END AS category,
    COALESCE(
        quantity,
        (SELECT median(quantity) FROM sales_data_bronze_6deed7f0)
    ) AS quantity,
    COALESCE(
        unit_price,
        (SELECT median(unit_price) FROM sales_data_bronze_6deed7f0)
    ) AS unit_price,
    COALESCE(
        total_amount,
        (SELECT median(total_amount) FROM sales_data_bronze_6deed7f0)
    ) AS total_amount,
    CASE
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(customer_segment)) LIKE 'prem%'                     THEN 'Premium'
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(customer_segment)) LIKE 'bgt%' OR LOWER(TRIM(customer_segment)) LIKE 'budg%' THEN 'Budget'
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(customer_segment)) LIKE 'stand%' OR LOWER(TRIM(customer_segment)) LIKE 'std%'  THEN 'Standard'
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(customer_segment)) LIKE 'loyal%'                    THEN 'Loyal'
        ELSE customer_segment
    END AS customer_segment,
    COALESCE(payment_method, 'Unknown') AS payment_method,
    _load_timestamp,
    _source_file
FROM sales_data_bronze_6deed7f0
WHERE store_id IS NOT NULL
  AND product_id IS NOT NULL
  AND product_name IS NOT NULL
  AND _load_timestamp IS NOT NULL
  AND _source_file IS NOT NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT
    store_name,
    region,
    city,
    state,
    _load_timestamp,
    _source_file
FROM stores_bronze_6deed7f0
WHERE store_name IS NOT NULL
  AND region IS NOT NULL
  AND city IS NOT NULL
  AND state IS NOT NULL
  AND _load_timestamp IS NOT NULL
  AND _source_file IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
    category,
    AVG(standard_price) AS avg_standard_price
FROM
    products_silver_6deed7f0
GROUP BY
    category
ORDER BY
    avg_standard_price DESC;
